name: privacy-browser-agent
description: PRIVIS: On-device Visual Perception for Light-weight Browser Agents

scripts.build: node scripts/copy-ort-assets.mjs && esbuild background/service-worker.ts utils/dom-extractor.ts privacy/sanitizer/structural-redact.ts content/capture-content.ts privacy/engine/vision/ort-runtime.ts privacy/engine/vision/face-detector.ts privacy/engine/vision/face-pipeline.ts privacy/engine/fuse.ts --bundle --format=iife --loader:.md=text --outdir=dist && esbuild extension/src/popup/popup.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/popup/popup.js && esbuild extension/src/offscreen/offscreen.ts --bundle --format=iife --loader:.md=text --outfile=dist/offscreen/offscreen.js
scripts.test:vision: npm run build && esbuild privacy/engine/vision/test-ort-runtime.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist-test/test-ort-runtime.mjs && node dist-test/test-ort-runtime.mjs
scripts.test:face: npm run build && esbuild privacy/engine/vision/test-face-detector.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist-test/test-face-detector.mjs && node dist-test/test-face-detector.mjs
scripts.test:face-pipeline: npm run build && esbuild privacy/engine/vision/test-face-pipeline.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist-test/test-face-pipeline.mjs && node dist-test/test-face-pipeline.mjs
scripts.test:privacy: npm run build && esbuild privacy/engine/vision/test-privacy-boundary.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist-test/test-privacy-boundary.mjs && node dist-test/test-privacy-boundary.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:cba && npm run test:navigate && npm run test:router && npm run test:guard && npm run test:privacy && npm run test:popup && npm run test:loop && npm run test:session-e2e && npm run test:settings && npm run test:goal
